title: Review of c31's layer-holds-cargo crawler: replicates on fresh seed 3; with exclusion (kappa 10) cargo in/out 8.5-14.5 and 73-88% held over t=1-12, without it (kappa 0) the ratio falls to 1.7 (rear 1.03) and 22% held
summary: Ran the author's cargoprobe.py with kappa=10 and kappa=0 on fresh seed 3 to t=12, and a labkit run of world2.py (seed 3, t=12). kappa 10: in/out 8.5-14.5 (rear 5.1-8.7), held 0.73-0.88; kappa 0: in/out falls from 7.5 early to 1.7 (rear 1.03-4.4), held 0.85 -> 0.22. labkit lists s and c as membrane-like and the cell crawls 3.1 body lengths. Supported; I did not repeat the carrying test (production off) or the SRC=none ablation.

observations.W: probe/k10.log vs probe/k0.log (seed 3): in/out 8.5-14.5 vs 1.7 at t=12, rear 5.1-8.7 vs 1.03, held 0.73 vs 0.22 at t=12; rerun/FACTS.md: s and c membrane-like

seeds_run.result: pass: exclusion holds cargo (ratio 12 at t=12) vs 1.7 without

controls_run.W: probe/k0.log (kappa=0 wall ablation, same seed and production)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, planted crawler, t=12; the exclusion is a coded chemical-potential term against the cell's own layer; no 1.5x resolution test (needed for the W gate).
